question.text: Form 3.1 adopted by the Social Stock Exchanges is prescribed as the format of:

answer.text: Quarterly statement of utilisation of funds under Regulation 91F.
Draft fund-raising document for ZCZP issuance.

explanation.text: The Logic: As per the SSE reporting-forms circular, Form 3.1 is the Format of Annual Social Impact Assessment Report - the actual SIA assessment document that accompanies the AIR for a listed project under Reg 91E. The Trap: Quarterly utilisation has no specific 'Form 3.1' - it is its own template under 91F. Draft fund-raising document is governed by 292K schedule, not Form 3.1. Governance filings flow through Form 1A/1B. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII Topic 7 (Reporting) and this Topic 9 both test Form 3.1 as SIA's deliverable. Parallel to the SA 700 auditor's report in III-A, but specific to SSE. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When signing Form 3.1, append a standard Basis of Opinion paragraph that names the SAS standards applied (SAS-100 to SAS-1600 as relevant), the sample size, the MoV triangulation and the assumptions tested. Thin boilerplate Basis paragraphs invite SIAB quality-review scrutiny.
